Claim 281 (currently amended): A tool comprising: a first adhesive layer; a second adhesive layer; and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

Claim 290 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a honeycomb structure.

Claim 291 (currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the ring includes a central opening. 

Claim 293 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281 further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

Claim 294 (currently amended): The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is continuous.
